purpose: Canonical acceptance rules for class-bound formulation schemas (F1, F2a, F2b). Binding only after review; a gate that implements these rules decides structure, never physical truth.

genericity_kind_definitions.residual_comeager: exists G = intersection of countably many open dense sets; P holds for every D in G
genericity_kind_definitions.full_measure: exists a set of full measure for a DECLARED measure mu; undefined without the measure
genericity_kind_definitions.open_dense_escape: exists a nonempty dense OPEN set U; P holds for every D in U
genericity_kind_definitions.dense_escape: the set where P holds is dense; not necessarily open, not necessarily comeager
genericity_kind_definitions.finite_codimension_complement: the exceptional set is contained in a countable union of finite-codimension submanifolds
genericity_kind_definitions.none: P holds for every admissible datum (no genericity quantifier)

genericity_implications: open_dense_escape => residual_comeager (a dense open set is comeager: constant countable intersection)
residual_comeager =/=> open_dense_escape (a comeager set can have empty interior, e.g. the irrationals)
residual_comeager => dense_escape (comeager sets are dense in a Baire space)
dense_escape =/=> residual_comeager (a dense meager set exists)
full_measure is incomparable with every topological notion in both directions
vocabularies.genericity_vocabulary_gap: a schema whose genericity is a hybrid (e.g. 'open in one topology and dense in another', as in one worker draft) cannot be expressed by a single token; such a schema must declare its own compound kind and record the two component notions explicitly rather than silently rounding to a vocabulary token
vocabularies.membership_ruling: class membership is set-level (D in G); a schema must not be read as deciding membership of an individual datum

rules.require: YAML/JSON mapping parses; schema_version, artifact_kind='class_schema', class_id in frozen_classes, node_id, owner, epistemic_status present
class_components decomposes class_id token-wise (AF/VAC/GEN plus WCC or SCC plus C2 xor C0) and regularity_token count matches family (SCC exactly one, WCC none)
rules.fail: class_id and class_components disagree, or regularity token count wrong for family

rules.require: quantifiers.ordered is a non-empty ordered list of {kind in [forall, exists, exists_unique, not_exists], binder, domain, domain_id}; quantifiers.formal is a single sentence using those binders; every domain_id resolves in quantifiers.domains and carries a non-vague definition (a banned vague word may appear only if the same entry has a 'definition_ref' or numeric content)
rules.fail: missing/unordered quantifiers, unresolved domain_id, or vague domain

rules.require: topology.spacetime_dimension=4; topology.slice_topology declares connected, complete, one-ended asymptotically flat slice; topology.conformal_boundary lists I+, I-, i0 with I+ topology 'R x S^2'; closed/periodic slices explicitly forbidden in topology.forbidden
rules.fail: topology incomplete or a closed/periodic slice is admitted

rules.require: data_class declares matter (none for VAC), cosmological_constant (0 for AF vacuum class), both constraint equations by name, ADM mass status, asymptotic decay as numeric rates per derivative order, and a named Sobolev index s and weight delta (or an explicit smooth-with-decay class with numeric rates)
rules.fail: data class vague or constraints/decay absent

rules.require: regularity block separates data_regularity, solution_regularity, i_plus_regularity, extension_regularity, extension_solution_concept; for SCC classes extension_regularity is exactly the class token (C2 xor C0) and extension_solution_concept is declared; must_not_conflate is a non-empty list
rules.fail: regularity slots merged or extension regularity mismatched/conflated

rules.require: genericity.kind in vocabulary; genericity.ambient_space and genericity.topology_or_measure named; genericity.generic_set defined as a set-builder or Baire formula; genericity.excluded_set present; genericity.transfer_failures non-empty; genericity.is_part_of_class=true with a statement that changing the notion yields a different class
rules.fail: genericity underspecified or treated as a free parameter

rules.require: non_vacuity exists with condition and witness_type; a non-vacuity witness is required before the class conclusion may be called non-trivial
rules.fail: no non-vacuity condition (schema admits trivially-satisfied reading)

rules.require: i_plus.role in vocabulary; role='conclusion' iff family=WCC; when role='conclusion' a completeness definition is present; when family=SCC, i_plus.in_conclusion=false and no completeness assertion inside i_plus
rules.fail: I+ role wrong for family, or SCC asserts I+ completeness

rules.require: visibility.role in vocabulary; WCC: role='conclusion' with predicate name, definition, and negation_conclusion; SCC: role='not_in_conclusion' with a reason and an explicit statement that a visible-singularity falsifier belongs to WCC
rules.fail: visibility missing or applied to the wrong family

rules.require: conclusion.conclusion_type equals vocabularies.class_conclusion_type[class_id]; conclusion.epistemic_status in epistemic_status vocabulary; forbidden_strengthenings non-empty; conclusion is not labelled 'theorem' without artifact_refs
rules.fail: conclusion type inflated, mismatched, or unsupported

rules.require: lexical leakage scan over leakage_scan_blocks only: no foreign-family token (SCC token in WCC blocks or vice versa) and no foreign matter/asymptotic token; occurrences inside anti_scope/variants are exempt but must be tagged
no composite regularity class anywhere outside an explicit forbidden-phrase quotation: regex (C0|C2)\s*(or|and|/)\s*(C0|C2) and mixed tokens in extension_regularity

falsifier.tier_1 refutes the class (must include a genericity/robustness requirement), falsifier.tier_2 refutes only a strengthening and is labelled as such; falsifier.witness_type present; falsifier.machine_checkable_steps non-empty; SCC tier_1 witness is an extension witness (extension_regularity), WCC tier_1 witness is a visible incomplete causal geodesic
rules.fail: falsifier cannot falsify the stated class or is of the wrong family

rules.require: provenance.citation_status in vocabulary; if 'verified' then at least one source with identifier and retrieval date; unresolved_citations list present; no source is presented as establishing the class conclusion

implication_ledger records the one-way statements (extension-class containment C2 subset C0; therefore C0-inextendibility entails C2-inextendibility) and marks the converse and any WCC<->SCC transfer as forbidden_or_unresolved
rules.fail: implication ledger missing or states a forbidden transfer

fixture_requirements.positive: >=2 conforming fixtures, one WCC and one SCC
fixture_requirements.negative: >=12 mutants, each keyed to exactly one expected rule id; no mutant may silently pass
fixture_requirements.rephrased: >=6 mutants that leak semantics without forbidden tokens; a passed rephrased mutant is a documented blind spot, not a pass

non_goals: no judgement that a named source proves the class conclusion
